name: Eszopiclone

tolerance.full: within a couple of weeks of daily use

toxicities: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like benzodiazepines, alcohol or opioids
summary: The d-isomer of Zopiclone, this drug is a potent hypnotic 'Z' drug often used to treat insomnia. High doses may cause amnesia, delirium and lowered inhibitions. Should not be combined with any depressants. Limited recreational value.
metabolism: CYP3A4 and CYP2E1 participate in oxidation and demethylation. Metabolites predominate in urinary elimination; only a small fraction is excreted as unchanged eszopiclone.
